meta.description: Immutable historical birth records with explicit local time standard provenance and UTC derivation analysis.

figures.name: Swami Vivekananda
figures.interpretationReason: Kolkata observed Local Mean Time (UTC+5:53:27) in 1863 prior to Indian Railway Time (1870) and prior to nationwide IST (+5:30) adoption in 1906.
figures.historicalUncertaintyNotes: Some classical Bengali astrologers use Sunrise instant as 06:31:30 vs 06:33:00. This produces a ~0°20' shift in Lagna but preserves Sagittarius (Dhanu) Ascendant.

figures.name: Mahatma Gandhi
figures.interpretationReason: Porbandar observed Local Mean Time (UTC+4:38:31) in 1869. B.V. Raman (Notable Horoscopes) and BV Raman 300 Combinations establish 07:11 LMT yielding Libra (Tula 17°) Lagna.
figures.historicalUncertaintyNotes: If erroneously calculated with standard IST (+5:30), birth instant shifts by 51 minutes to 01:41 UTC, corrupting the Ascendant into Virgo. LMT is mandatory.

figures.name: Albert Einstein
figures.location: Ulm, Kingdom of Württemberg, German Empire
figures.interpretationReason: Germany standardized on Central European Time (CET UTC+1) on April 1, 1893. Birth on 14 March 1879 strictly followed Ulm Local Mean Time (UTC+0:39:57).
figures.historicalUncertaintyNotes: Applying CET (+1.0) shifts the birth instant by 20 minutes to 10:30 UTC, which alters the Lagna by ~5°.

figures.name: Narendra Modi
figures.location: Vadnagar, Mehsana District, Gujarat / Bombay State, India
figures.interpretationReason: Post-independence India officially established Indian Standard Time (UTC+5:30) as the sole legal civil time standard across all states and provinces.
figures.historicalUncertaintyNotes: Civil time standard is 100% certain (IST +5:30). Reported birth times in biographical public media vary between 09:34, 11:00, and 12:09.
